s: Which of the following state got the largest share as per the horizontal sharing in tax devolution recommended by the 14% Finance Commission?
x: Under the 14th Finance Commission's horizontal devolution, Uttar Pradesh, the most populous State, got the largest share, 17.959% (AP 4.305%, MP 7.548%, West Bengal 7.324%). The stem's '14%' means the 14th Finance Commission.

s: Who is the Chairman of the 14th Finance Commission?
x: The 14th Finance Commission (constituted 2 January 2013) was chaired by former RBI Governor Y.V. Reddy and raised the States' share of the divisible pool from 32% to 42%. Vijay Kelkar chaired the 13th FC and N.K. Singh the 15th.

s: The Chairman of the 6th Central Pay Commission is
x: Justice B.N. Srikrishna (retired SC judge) chaired the Sixth Central Pay Commission, constituted in 2006 (report 2008). The 7th CPC was chaired by Justice Ashok Kumar Mathur and the 8th by Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai.

s: How many members are there in Prime Minister's Financial Advisory Council?
x:
the 5-member Rangarajan council ended in 2014 — now the EAC-PM (reconstituted 25 Sep 2017) is chaired by S. Mahendra Dev (2025), with about 11 members including the chairman (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Economic_Advisory_Council_to_the_Prime_Minister)
In 2010-11 the PM's Economic Advisory Council had five members: Chairman C. Rangarajan with Suman K. Bery, Saumitra Chaudhuri, M. Govinda Rao and V.S. Vyas (reconstituted August 2009). (Now the EAC-PM, re-formed in 2017, is chaired by S. Mahendra Dev and has a larger membership.)

s: The chairman of the Sixth Pay Commission is:
x: Justice B.N. Srikrishna chaired the Sixth Central Pay Commission (constituted 2006). Justice R.S. Pathak was a Chief Justice of India and Justice B.D. Ahmed a Delhi HC judge, not Pay Commission chairs.

s: Justice K. Venkataswamy resigned as chairman of the Tehelka.com inquiry commission into bribery in defence purchases. Who was appointed in his place?
x: Justice K. Venkataswami resigned from the Tehelka inquiry commission in November 2002 (accepted 24 Nov 2002); Justice S.N. Phukan, retired SC judge, was named in his place (notified January 2003). The commission was wound up in 2004.

s: Justice K. Venkataswami resigned from the post of the head of the Commission of Enquiry of Tehelka.com regarding corruption in defence purchases. Who was appointed in his place as the head of the Commission?
x: After Justice K. Venkataswami resigned (accepted 24 Nov 2002), Justice S.N. Phukan, a retired Supreme Court judge, was appointed to head the Tehelka Commission of Inquiry (notified January 2003); it was wound up in 2004.

s: Who of the following suggested the creation of an Autonomous Education commission on the lines of the Supreme Court and Election Commission and favoured the creation of Bharatiya Educational Services ?
x: Dinanath Batra (Shiksha Sanskriti Utthan Nyas) proposed in 2015 an education commission 'just like the Election Commission' to insulate education from regime changes, run by a 'Bharatiya Education Service'.
